outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic/diagram showing single calculated percentage values (illumination overhead) for each exposure-time condition; it is not an average of replicate measurements, so individual data points are not applicable.

Photobleaching decay curves represent the mean of three independent experiments (shaded area = mean±s.e.m.), but only the averaged curve with shading is shown; the individual experiment traces/data points are not displayed.
CellROX data are shown as mean±s.e.m. of three independent experiments as a line plot, but the individual replicate values/curves are not shown.

Migration tracks show the raw path of each individual migrating cell (not an averaged summary statistic), so this panel already displays individual data rather than an average that would require underlying points.
The bar graph of migration speed (mean±s.e.m.) has individual cell data points overlaid as dots on each bar.
Panel F consists of representative micrographs, not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
Panel G consists of time-lapse micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel H consists of time-lapse micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Cell morphology (normalized area) is plotted as mean±s.e.m. (n=5 cells) over time without showing the individual cell values/points behind each mean.
Mitochondrial morphology (normalized area) is plotted as mean±s.e.m. (n=5 cells) over time without showing the individual cell values/points behind each mean.
